hint.label: BC
hint.text: BC stands for Before Christ, which records the years that happened before Jesus was said to have been born. 776 BC was roughly 2,800 years ago!

atoms.text: Do you know how the Olympic Games started? Let’s go back in time to the year 776 BC in ancient Greece, to a small town called Olympia.

instruction.text: What do we call the stories about the gods and heroes of ancient Greece? Spell the word.

hint.label: Ancient Greece
hint.text: Ancient Greece wasn’t an official country, like we know Greece today. It was a large area made up of several Greek city states.

feedback.end: Myths were very important for the ancient Greeks! The word comes from the ancient Greek word mythos, which means story. The ancient Greeks had countless stories about gods and heroes and did all they could to honour them.

instruction.text: This is Zeus — the king of the gods in Greek mythology. Look at the image and answer the questions.

atoms.a: What do you think he is the god of?

feedback.end: There are lots of different myths about how the Olympic Games started. One thing we do know is that they were held to honour Zeus!

instruction.text: This is Olympia, where the Games were held. Select the track to learn more.

end.text: Olympia was a key religious sanctuary (a holy place of worship) for Zeus. There was once a temple for him here with a giant statue of him inside! That was why the Games were held here.
end.sound: Olympia was a key religious sanctuary, a holy place of worship, for Zeus. There was once a temple for him here with a giant statue of him inside! That was why the Games were held here.

instruction.text: This is Heracles — a legendary hero and son of Zeus. Select him to hear the myth about him and the Olympics.
instruction.sound: This is Heracleese — a legendary hero and son of Zeus. Select him to hear the myth about him and the Olympics.

atoms.sound: I must complete these twelve challenges given to me.

atoms.text: Heracles had been given twelve incredibly difficult challenges, called labours. These included defeating monsters and obtaining special objects.

atoms.sound: Twelve years have passed, and I have completed all the labours.

instruction.text: After completing the labours, Heracles wanted to find a way to honour his father, Zeus. Listen to the options and select what you think he did.
instruction.sound: After completing the labours, Heracleese wanted to find a way to honour his father, Zeus. Listen to the options and select what you think he did.

feedback.end: Keep in mind that this is just a made-up story, so we don’t know the exact historical truth. However, myths do tell us about what the people at the time believed in and valued!

b.sound: He started an athletic festival for people to compete in the honour of Zeus.
He poked Zeus in the face and ran away.
